system.effect:
Prerequisites: @UUID[Compendium.ptu.references.Item.rcbGdymMIaMsrcyY]
1 AP – Standard Action
Effect: A cloud of Steam Hazards erupt in a Blast 3 centered on you; the Steam persists until the end of the encounter, or until @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.qmduvRZ9fs3R2Mrt] or @UUID[Compendium.ptu.moves.Item.DCD0giVPub7Agz5U] are used. All targets attacking from or into the Steam receive a -3 penalty to Accuracy. All creatures in the Steam at the start of their turn that are not immune to Burns take a tick of damage.
